_comment: Reference locale. Keys are grouped by screen area. {placeholders} are substituted at runtime and must be preserved in every translation.
lang.label: Language
gate.login.subtitle: Protected access
gate.setup.title: Welcome
gate.setup.subtitle: Choose a password to protect this device.
gate.setup.warning: Until a password is set, anyone on your network can configure this streamer. Set one now.
player.volume_locked_title: Volume locked — set the level on your amplifier
player.volume_locked_hint: Volume locked: the DAC sits at full output and never attenuates. Set the level on your amplifier.
audio.title: Audio output
audio.volume_mode_hint: “Locked” holds the DAC at full output and leaves the volume to your amplifier — the classic fixed line output. Otherwise the slider above drives the DAC's own attenuator, which keeps the stream bit-perfect.
audio.gapless_hint: Plays tracks back to back with no silence — worthwhile on a live album or a continuous mix. Known drawback: prefetching can swallow a track change requested from the Qobuz app, which then keeps playing the previous track.
qobuz.title: Qobuz account
qobuz.url_hint: Open this link in your browser to authorise the device:
qconnect.title: Qobuz Connect
qconnect.name_label: Name shown in the Qobuz app
system.title: System status
wifi.title: Wi-Fi network
wifi.warning_body: You are viewing this page over Wi-Fi. If the change fails, the device automatically returns to the previous network. But if it succeeds and you moved to a different network, the Pi will disappear from this one — you will have to join the new network to reach it again.
wifi.psk_placeholder: Leave empty for an open network
wifi.confirm:
Join “{ssid}”?

If the connection fails, the device will return to the current network automatically.
If it succeeds and this is a different network, this page will stop responding: you will need to join “{ssid}” to reach the streamer again.
wifi.no_response: No response ({error}). If the network changed, join it and reload this page.
security.title: Security
banner.power_body: The Pi reports {flags} right now. Use a 5.1 V / 2.5 A supply — this is the leading cause of dropouts.
banner.nopw_body: Anyone on your network can change these settings.
banner.thermal_body: The Pi is reducing its speed to cool down. Check ventilation around the case.
player.volume_hardware_hint: Hardware volume, applied inside the DAC ({control}) — the stream stays bit-perfect.
player.volume_unavailable_title: This DAC exposes no volume control
player.volume_unavailable_hint: Volume is unavailable: this converter exposes no hardware volume control, and software attenuation is disabled in bit-perfect mode. Use your amplifier.
banner.stream_error_note: kept until the daemon restarts, so it may already be resolved.
nav.label: View
wizard.title: Setup
wizard.skip_confirm:
Skip the setup wizard?

Nothing is lost — every setting stays available under Settings, and you can run the wizard again from Settings › Security.
wizard.step.name: Name
wizard.network.title: Network
wizard.network.intro: The streamer is already reachable, or you would not be reading this. This step is here so you can confirm which network it is on before anything else depends on it.
wizard.network.hint: To move it to a different Wi-Fi network, use Settings › Network after finishing setup — changing networks now would interrupt this page.
wizard.dac.title: Choose your DAC
wizard.dac.intro: Pick the converter to play into. Its real capabilities are read from the hardware, not from a specification sheet.
wizard.dac.none: No USB audio device found. Check that the DAC is plugged in and switched on, then go back and forward again to rescan.
wizard.qobuz.title: Sign in to Qobuz
wizard.qobuz.intro: Authorisation opens in a new tab and comes back on its own. A valid Qobuz subscription is required; no password is stored on this device.
wizard.name.title: Name and quality
wizard.name.intro: The name is what you will tap in the Qobuz app to send music here.
wizard.done.title: Ready
wizard.done.intro: Here is what has been set. Everything below can be changed later under Settings.
wizard.done.hint: Open Qobuz on your phone or desktop, tap the Connect icon and choose this device.
wizard.rerun_hint: Runs through DAC, Qobuz sign-in and naming again. Nothing is reset — each step simply shows what is currently configured.
maint.title: qbzd software
maint.upgrade_hint: Installs the newest upstream release. Worth knowing before you press it: the Qobuz Connect protocol is reverse-engineered, so a new version is also the most likely way for a working streamer to stop appearing in the Qobuz app. The previous binary is kept as /usr/bin/qbzd.bak.
maint.upgrade_confirm:
Upgrade qbzd to {version}?

Playback stops while the daemon restarts. The current version is kept as qbzd.bak so it can be restored over SSH if the new one misbehaves.
maint.upgrading_hint: Downloading and installing. This can take a couple of minutes on a Pi 3B.
maint.upgraded: Upgraded to {version} (was {previous}). SHA-256: {sha} — record it as qbzd_sha256 in group_vars/all.yml, otherwise the next provision reinstalls the older pinned version.
maint.daemon_failed: the daemon did not restart cleanly: {error}
maint.restart_hint: Restarting qbzd stops playback for a few seconds. Restarting this interface disconnects the page briefly — reload it afterwards. A reboot takes about a minute.
maint.confirm_web:
Restart the web interface?

This page will lose its connection for a few seconds. Reload it once the streamer answers again.
maint.confirm_reboot:
Reboot the streamer?

Playback stops and the device is unreachable for about a minute.
maint.web_started: Interface restarting — reload in a few seconds
maint.reboot_started: Rebooting — this page will come back in about a minute
logs.title: Logs
reset.title: Factory reset
reset.warning_body: Removes the Qobuz sign-in, every qbzd setting, the device name and this interface's password. The streamer returns to its just-provisioned state and the setup wizard starts again.
reset.keeps: What it does not touch: the operating system, audio configuration, boot settings and Wi-Fi credentials. The Pi stays on your network and stays reachable at the same address.
reset.confirm:
Factory reset?

The Qobuz sign-in, all qbzd settings and this interface's password will be deleted. The Pi stays on the network — only its configuration goes.
reset.mistyped: Reset cancelled — the word did not match.
reset.done: Reset complete. Reloading — you will be asked to set a new password.
